mathematics: For x > 0, f(x) = x^x > 0 and ln f(x) = x ln x. Thus f'(x)/f(x) = 1 + ln x, giving the unique stationary point x = e^(-1). Because f is positive and 1 + ln x changes from negative to positive there, this is the global minimum on the stated domain. The retained justification is valid: at the stationary point, f'' = f·d(1 + ln x)/dx = ef > 0.
